title: Agent controls
responsibility: Lets a person choose an available agent provider, model and reasoning effort, and exposes the resulting choice to its parent.

inputs.name: AgentControls.providers
inputs.description: Each record carries the provider id, label, availability, reason, version, image-generation flag and model choices; each model includes its id, label, effort names, nullable default effort and default flag. Provider ids (codex or claude), model ids and effort names act as list keys and must be unique within their rendered lists; compact mode switches an unavailable current provider to the first available provider, and an empty list shows a no-provider notice.

inputs.name: AgentControls.choice
inputs.description: Bindable value written by this component: the current provider id, model id and nullable effort, or null. It is set to null unless the selected provider is available and the model string is nonempty; the supplied value does not initialize the internal pickers, and an empty effort becomes null.

inputs.name: AgentControls.compact
inputs.description: Selects the rendered layout and defaults to false. True renders icon pickers; false renders provider buttons and model and reasoning-effort selects.

inputs.name: AgentControls.action
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered after the pickers in compact mode and after the selects in expanded mode.

outputs.name: AgentControls
outputs.description: Renders either the compact picker row or the expanded provider-button and model/effort-select layouts, followed by the required action snippet. It adds the current provider's reason when truthy and the no-provider notice when the provider list is empty.

errors.name: Duplicate row key
errors.description: Rendering a keyed list can throw when duplicate IDs or effort strings occur among its entries: provider IDs and model IDs are keyed by id, and efforts are keyed by their string value.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: An error thrown by the supplied action snippet propagates when it is rendered because this component does not catch snippet errors.
